# MA Propane Delivery Tariffs
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(jsonlite)
library(RSQLite)
library(readxl)

source("/workspaces/reports/lib/ggplot/switchbox_theme.R")

library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)

url_sheet_delivery_tariffs_fueloil_ma <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1UDvrB0dhjY_8M8cnxsdbgAuoW95F6bm670V7SAROAAo/edit?gid=658606865#gid=658606865"
googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
tariffs_fueloil_raw <- read_sheet(url_sheet_delivery_tariffs_fueloil_ma, sheet = "tariffs")

summer_months <- c(5,6,7,8,9,10)
winter_months <- c(11,12,1,2,3,4)

# The tariffs are specified by season, so we need to expand them out to the monthly grid
delivery_tariffs_fueloil <- tariffs_fueloil_raw |>
  mutate(
    month = if_else(season == "summer",
                    list(summer_months),
                    list(winter_months))
  ) |>
  select(-season) |>
  unnest(month) |>
  arrange(month)

#path_rs_db <- "data/ResStock/2022_resstock_amy2018_release_1.1/rs_ma_hp_rates.db"
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), path_rs_db)
DBI::dbWriteTable(
  con,
  "delivery_tariffs_fueloil",
  delivery_tariffs_fueloil,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```
